Sub-Zero Pauldrons drop from Baron Aquanis in Blackfathom Deeps.
Stygia Residue is located on the rafters of the Altar of Domination in the Maw. It is only visible while carrying the Stygia Dowser. The Stygia Convergence can be found to the southeast.

Stygia Convergence is located on a tower southeast of the Altar of Domination in the Maw. Its location is hinted at by the Stygia Residue and is only visible while carrying the Stygia Dowser. The dowser can be used here to activate Stygia Delirium and complete the rune puzzle to obtain the Crumbling Stele from the Runed Chest.
Student Fodder gives you four bars of rested experience when used.
Student of Suffering is a Scarred demon hunter hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Flamebound.
Stumpers is a corgi located in the Dalaran Pet Tournament in Dalaran.
Stubborn Animate is a Maldraxxi skeleton located in Maldraxxus.
Sturdy Nerubian Carapace has a chance to drop from mobs summoned by Disturbed Earths on Khaz Algar.
Sturdy Chitinous Striders drop from the following world bosses: *Kordac on the Isle of Dorn *The Aggregation of Horrors in the Ringing Deeps *Shurrai in Hallowfall *Orta in Azj-Kahet
Subterranean Dartswogs are frogs located throughout the areas of Khaz Algar.
Stubborn Wolf's Greathelm drops from Matriarch Charfuria in Cinderwold on the Isle of Dorn.
Subterfuge in Silk is an optional breadcrumb available after completing the Azj-Kahet campaign.
Submerged Sign is a found in the Living Grotto in the Ringing Deeps. As a one-time bonus, interacting with this object grants +250 reputation with the Assembly of the Deeps.

Studded Timbermaw Brawlers are upgraded from Timbermaw Brawlers#Classic at Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold. The upgrade costs 1 Cured Rugged Hide and 20 Winterfall Spirit Beads and requires with Timbermaw Hold.
The Student's Surprising Surplus can be found at the Triumvirate's End in Eredath.

The Sturmvyn clan of iron vrykul originated from the Storm Peaks. They left the region following the disappearance of Thorim and prior to the Winterskorn's war, guided by their leader Cyrce to an area that would become known as the Siren Isle.
Stuck Tuskarr Kite is a kite located above Morqut Village in the Forbidden Reach. During Up to the Highest Height!, they can be pulled on. They then spawn Broken Kite Pieces on the ground.
